vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: seo-content-pro
Version: 1.3.0

The skill bundle provides a comprehensive set of tools for SEO content creation, including AI detection, text humanization, and image generation. The Python scripts (detect_ai.py, humanize.py, and generate_image.py) perform standard text processing and API interactions with Google Gemini as documented, with no evidence of malicious execution, data exfiltration, or harmful prompt injection. The code is well-structured, lacks obfuscation, and aligns perfectly with its stated purpose.

llm.summary: The skill's code and runtime instructions partially match its description, but several important claimed features (search/research, competitor analysis, SEO scoring) are missing or not implemented, and the SKILL.md explicitly instructs text 'humanization' to bypass AI detectors — this combination is inconsistent and warrants caution.

dimensions.detail: The name/description promise a full SEO pipeline (topic research, competitor analysis, SEO scoring, content refresh). The included repo only contains: AI-detection/humanization scripts, image generation (requires Gemini API), a title generator, and an A/B test simulator. There is no script that performs automated web research/scraping of top-10 pages, no SEO scoring module, and no competitor-analysis code. The registry metadata also lists curl as required even though no script uses it directly. Several claimed capabilities are not implemented in the code bundle — this is an incoherence between advertised purpose and actual capabilities.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md instructs the agent to research top-10 results using a SearXNG instance and to 'humanize' AI-generated text specifically to bypass AI detectors. The code contains humanize/detect scripts (local transformations) and a generate_image script, but no automated research/search implementation. The explicit instruction to transform text to evade detectors is ethically questionable and could encourage deceptive use; the research step is underspecified and not backed by code in the package.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: There is no install specification (instruction-only), which reduces disk-write risk. However, several scripts import third-party Python libraries (google.genai, pillow) and include commented dependency hints, yet no automated install is provided. The absence of dependency installation instructions may lead users to manually install packages (operational risk) and the declared required binary 'curl' is not present in the codebase, which is inconsistent with SKILL.md claiming SearXNG research (curl might be expected there but no script implements it).
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The registry lists no required environment variables; SKILL.md documents optional env vars (CONTENT_TONE, DEFAULT_LENGTH, CONTENT_LANGUAGE, SEARXNG_URL) and the image script expects GEMINI_API_KEY if generating images. These are proportionate to the stated features. No unrelated credentials (AWS, DB passwords, etc.) are requested. That said, GEMINI_API_KEY gives the skill network access to Google GenAI endpoints when used; the humanization feature also raises ethical concerns despite not needing secrets.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill does not request always:true and does not appear to modify other skills or global agent configs. It can be invoked autonomously (platform default) but there is no evidence of elevated persistence/privileges in the bundle.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance:
Key things to consider before installing:
- Inconsistent capabilities: The README/SKILL.md advertise research, competitor analysis, and SEO scoring, but the included code only implements detection/humanization, title generation, image generation (requires GEMINI_API_KEY), and an A/B simulator. If you expect automatic top-10 scraping or SEO scoring, this package doesn't provide it.
- Humanization to 'bypass AI detectors': The humanize.py is explicitly built to modify text to evade AI detection. That is ethically and potentially legally risky (could facilitate deception or policy violations). Consider whether you want to use software whose stated purpose is to bypass classifiers.
- Dependencies and network calls: generate_image.py uses google.genai and Pillow and will call Google endpoints when run with a GEMINI_API_KEY. There is no automated install for these dependencies in the package; you would need to install them manually in a safe environment. The SKILL.md lists curl and a SearXNG URL for research, but no script implements SearXNG querying — verify whether the agent itself will perform network research or whether additional scripts are expected.
- Source provenance: The skill has no homepage and an unknown source; the package.json points to a GitHub repo but you should verify that remote repository and check for recent commits/issues.
- Recommended actions: inspect the code yourself (or in a sandbox), verify network behavior when running generate_image.py with an API key, decide whether you are comfortable with the humanization feature, and ask the author for missing implementations (research, SEO scorer) or remove/disable the humanize functionality if you plan only legitimate use. If in doubt, test in an isolated environment and avoid providing high-privilege credentials.
